# Replaces the IDF default single-app layout. What changed and why:
#   - factory grows from 1500 KB to 2 MB. The Wi-Fi Service pushed the app
#     binary from 702 KB to 1359 KB
#     11-15 still have to add code (PC Monitor link
#     Assets). 2 MB leaves about 690 KB of headroom.
#   - A dedicated `assets` data partition is reserved for resources that must
#     not live in the app slot: a full Chinese font (about 0.93 MB for the
#     6763 GB2312 glyphs at 16 px / 4bpp) plus icons and sounds. That work
#     belongs to node 15 "Assets and file system" (design doc section 15).
#     The partition stays unused
#   - nvs keeps its offset (0xA000) and size (24 KB)
#     and Wi-Fi credentials are untouched by this change. phy_init and the
#     factory offset (0x20000
column2: required to be 64 KB aligned) are unchanged
